facts.text: Snow left Css Lab (6,890 ft) and Independence Lake (8,340 ft) 22 to 26 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Css Lab
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: June 16 (2023), May 20 (2024), May 15 (2025)

evidence.name: Independence Lake
evidence.detail: left June 8; earlier seasons: July 21 (2023), June 25 (2024), June 30 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Css Lab (6,890 ft) and Independence Lake (8,340 ft).

evidence.name: Css Lab
evidence.detail: 4.0 in on April 12; earlier seasons: 77.5 in (2023), 40.3 in (2024), 33.9 in (2025)

evidence.name: Independence Lake
evidence.detail: 22.8 in on April 23; earlier seasons: 78.8 in (2023), 44.0 in (2024), 49.6 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 27 and June 20, carried from the melt-out dates at Css Lab (6,890 ft) and Independence Lake (8,340 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Css Lab
evidence.detail: melted out April 24, 1,136 ft below the pass; points to April 14 to June 13

evidence.name: Independence Lake
evidence.detail: melted out June 8, 314 ft above the pass; points to May 10 to June 26
